title: pcell yield selection replicates on seed 3: low-yield share 0.46 -> 0.10 vs neutral 0.52 -> 0.59; 6/0 splits from pure high- vs low-yield cells; 1 death
summary: Fresh seed 3, the author's genealogy.py to t=16000. y2=0.7 arm: the low-yield particle share inside cells falls 0.46 (t=550) -> 0.20 (t=8250) -> 0.10 (t=16000); 7 persistent splits, 6 from pure high-yield parents, 0 from pure low-yield parents, 1 mixed; 1 death, 0 merges, 0 off-kind daughters, 0 conversions of pure cells. Neutral arm (y2=1.0) on the same seed: 0.52 -> 0.60 -> 0.59; 12 persistent splits, 11 from mixed parents, 0 deaths. labkit pack of the y2=0.7 arm (rerun_y07/particles.png): cells purify by t~2600, low-yield (cyan) cells stay small and never divide while high-yield (white) cells grow, elongate and split.

observations.F: data/share.txt: kind-1 share 0.46 -> 0.10 (y2=0.7) vs 0.52 -> 0.59 (neutral); data/g_y0.7_s3.log splits by pure parent kind 6/0; rerun_y07/particles.png t=2600-10000

controls_run.F: data/g_neu_s3.log and data/share.txt (neutral arm y2=1.0, seed 3)

verdicts.limitation: As the finding states, this is colonization-phase selection with kinds seeded 50/50 and only 1 death in the run; the neutral arm also drifts (+0.07). I did not re-run the gate-off ablation or the y2=1.3 arm.
